TRANSPORT_RAW.notes: Raw inbound material is retained for provenance and replay.

IDENTITY_MASTER.notes: Canonical identity records require the strongest verifier controls.

SEMANTIC_MASTER.notes: Semantic master data defines the canonical graph interpretation.

ASSERTION.notes: Assertions are preserved atomically and may conflict.

EVIDENCE_RECORD.notes: Evidence is append-oriented and never silently replaced.

CURRENT_STATE.notes: Current state is the latest accepted non-predictive projection.

HISTORICAL_RECORD.notes: Historical records remain queryable for audit and replay.

TARGET_STATE.notes: Target state expresses intent and never overwrites ACTUAL state.

PREDICTED_STATE.notes: Predictions are derived and must stay distinct from ACTUAL state.

RELATION_MASTER.notes: Canonical relations are preserved with provenance references.

EXECUTION_CONTROL.notes: Execution control requires an explicit executor and approval path.

RESULT_RECORD.notes: Result records capture observed execution outcomes.

AUDIT_PROVENANCE.notes: Audit provenance links ingests, claims, routes, and approvals.

CONFLICT_RECORD.notes: Conflicts remain open until explicit resolution.

ROUTING_INDEX.notes: Routing index records owner and consumer projections.

SEARCH_PROJECTION.notes: Search projections are denormalized read models.

CACHE.notes: Caches are disposable and never the semantic source of truth.
